<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Example 3.26(b) · p. 76</div>

::: {.notes}
Preserve the original wording. OneNote: substitute z=9/8 into x²+y²+z²=9 to obtain x²+y²=495/64. State both x²+y²=495/64 AND z=9/8. Centre (0,0,9/8), radius √495/8=3√55/8. Without the fixed z condition, x²+y²=495/64 in 3D is a cylinder, not the required circle. The supporting transparent diagram uses the actual radii 3 and 4 with centres (0,0,0),(0,0,4); it highlights the common circle without printing its numerical answers. In the diagram the height h denotes the value found in part (a).
:::
